ei.title: Chapter 0-QN38-39 1번: The Many Winners in Science
ei.subject: 올림포스9대변별유형

fullPassage: Science is sometimes described as a winner-take-all contest, meaning that there are no rewards for being second or third. This is an extreme view of the nature of scientific contests. Even those who describe scientific contests in such a way note that it is a somewhat inaccurate description, given that replication and verification have social value and are common in science. It is also inaccurate to the extent that it suggests that only a handful of contests exist. Yes, some contests are seen as world class, such as identification of the Higgs particle or the development of high temperature superconductors. But many other contests have multiple parts, and the number of such contests may be increasing. By way of example, for many years it was thought that there would be "one" cure for cancer, but it is now realized that cancer takes multiple forms and that multiple approaches are needed to provide a cure. There won't be one winner — there will be many.

❌ ④ modern(현대의): 시대의 축으로 의미 무관
det.tip: multiple(여럿의) ↔ single(단일의). various는 유사어라 함정

questions.passage:
(A) Science is sometimes described as a winner-take-all <u>contest</u>, meaning that there are no rewards for being second or third.

(B) The losing candidate decided to <u>contest</u> the election result in court.
questions.stem: 다음 (A)와 (B)의 밑줄 친 contest의 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: (A) contest = 경쟁·대회(명사) / (B) contest = 이의를 제기하다(동사)
det.analysis:
❌ ① (A) 이의를 제기하다 — (B) 경쟁: (A)(B) 의미가 서로 뒤바뀜
❌ ② (A) 대회 — (B) 계약: (B)는 계약이 아니라 결과에 '이의를 제기하다'
❌ ③ (A) 항의 — (B) 다투다: (A)는 항의가 아니라 '경쟁·대회'
✅ ④ (A) 경쟁 — (B) 이의를 제기하다: (A)는 winner-take-all contest(승자독식 경쟁), (B)는 contest the result(결과에 이의 제기) ←정답
det.tip: contest: 경쟁·대회(명사) / 이의를 제기하다·다투다(동사) — 문맥에 따라 의미가 달라짐

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "the process of repeating a study or experiment to check whether the same result appears"

det.korean: 연구·실험을 반복해 같은 결과가 나오는지 확인하는 과정 = replication(재현)
det.analysis:
❌ ① identification(발견·식별): 반복이 아니라 알아내는 것
✅ ② replication(재현): 연구를 반복해 결과를 재확인하는 과정 — 정의 일치 ←정답
❌ ③ description(서술): 반복 과정이 아니라 묘사
❌ ④ development(개발): 새로 만들어 발전시키는 것
det.tip: replication = 재현, 복제 (repeating a study to check the result)

questions.passage: Science is sometimes described as a winner-take-all contest, __________ (mean) that there are no rewards for being second or third. This is an extreme view of the nature of scientific contests.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: mean(동사: 의미하다) → meaning (현재분사) — 앞 절을 부연 설명하는 분사구문
det.analysis:
빈칸은 앞 절 전체를 부연하는 분사구문 자리. 동사 mean → 현재분사 meaning. 'a winner-take-all contest, meaning that ...' = 승자독식 경쟁인데, 이는 ~을 의미한다 (능동, 분사구문)
앞 절을 이어받아 부연 설명할 때는 현재분사를 쓴다.
det.tip: 분사구문: mean → meaning(현재분사, 능동). '~을 의미하면서'

questions.passage: Yes, some contests are seen as world class, such as __________ (identify) of the Higgs particle or the development of high temperature superconductors. But many other contests have multiple parts, and the number of such contests may be increasing.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: identify(동사: 확인하다) → identification (명사: 발견·확인) — such as 뒤 명사 자리
det.analysis:
빈칸은 'such as' 뒤, 'of the Higgs particle'의 수식을 받는 명사 자리. 동사 identify → 명사 identification. 'identification of the Higgs particle' = 힉스 입자의 발견
뒤의 the development와 대등하게 이어지는 병렬 구조이므로 명사형이 필요하다.
det.tip: identify(v.) → identification(n.). such as 뒤, of 앞은 명사 자리

questions.passage: Science is sometimes described as a winner-take-all contest, meaning that there are no rewards for being second or third. This is an extreme view of the nature of scientific contests. Even those who describe scientific contests in such a way note that it is a somewhat inaccurate description, given that replication and verification have social value and are common in science. It is also inaccurate to the extent that it suggests that only a handful of contests exist. Yes, some contests are seen as world class, such as identification of the Higgs particle or the development of high temperature superconductors. But many other contests have multiple parts, and the number of such contests may be increasing. __________, for many years it was thought that there would be "one" cure for cancer, but it is now realized that cancer takes multiple forms and that multiple approaches are needed to provide a cure. There won't be one winner — there will be many.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 예를 들자면(By way of example), 오랫동안 암의 치료법은 하나라 여겨졌다
det.analysis:
❌ ① In spite of this(이에도 불구하고): 앞 내용과의 양보 관계가 아님
❌ ② On the other hand(반면에): 대조가 아니라 예시를 드는 흐름
✅ ③ By way of example(예를 들자면): 앞의 '여러 부분을 가진 대회'를 암 사례로 예시 — 원문 일치 ←정답
❌ ④ Regardless of cost(비용과 상관없이): 문맥과 무관
det.tip: By way of example = 예를 들자면(= For example). 뒤에 구체적 사례(암 치료)가 이어짐

questions.passage: Science is sometimes described as a winner-take-all contest, meaning that there are no rewards for being second or third. This is an extreme view of the nature of scientific contests. Even those who describe scientific contests in such a way note that it is a somewhat inaccurate description, given that replication and verification have social value and are common in science. It is also inaccurate __________ that it suggests that only a handful of contests exist. Yes, some contests are seen as world class, such as identification of the Higgs particle or the development of high temperature superconductors. But many other contests have multiple parts, and the number of such contests may be increasing. By way of example, for many years it was thought that there would be "one" cure for cancer, but it is now realized that cancer takes multiple forms and that multiple approaches are needed to provide a cure. There won't be one winner — there will be many.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 그것이 소수의 대회만 존재한다고 시사하는 정도만큼(to the extent that) 부정확하다
det.analysis:
✅ ① to the extent(~하는 정도만큼): 소수 대회만 존재한다고 시사하는 '정도만큼' 부정확 — 원문 일치 ←정답
❌ ② for a short time(잠깐 동안): 시간 표현이라 뒤의 'that절'과 어울리지 않음
❌ ③ at first glance(언뜻 보기에): 뒤에 that절을 이끌 수 없어 비문
❌ ④ in the meantime(그 사이에): 시점 표현이라 문맥·구조 모두 부적절
det.tip: to the extent that ~ = ~하는 정도까지·만큼. 부정확함의 '정도'를 한정하는 유일한 짝
